segments.text: The security deposit is ₹75,000 (Rupees Seventy-Five Thousand Only), which equals 3 months of rent.

citations.quote: deposited with the Licensor a sum of Rs. 75,000/- (Rupees Seventy-Five Thousand Only) as Security Deposit, equivalent to 3 (Three) months' Licence Fee

segments.text: The monthly rent (licence fee) is ₹25,000, payable by the 5th of each month.

citations.quote: a monthly licence fee of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty-Five Thousand Only) payable on or before the 5th day of each calendar month

segments.text: The lock-in period is 6 months from the start of the agreement. During this time, you cannot terminate the agreement.

citations.quote: the first 6 months of the Agreement shall constitute a lock-in period during which the Licensee shall not be entitled to terminate this Agreement

segments.text: If you leave during the lock-in, you must pay 3 months' rent as penalty and lose the entire security deposit.

citations.quote: the Licensee shall be liable to pay a penalty equivalent to 3 (Three) months' Licence Fee, and the Security Deposit shall be forfeited in its entirety

is the property insured.abstention_reason: The document does not mention property insurance.
